# Voyola

> Voyola is a travel and services app designed to simplify the airport experience on a single digital platform, developed with a focus on the Istanbul Airport (IST) ecosystem. It brings together participating food & beverage locations, selected premium airport services (Lounge, Fast Track, Buggy — coming soon), an easy payment experience at participating locations, and Voyola-only benefits and rewards.

Tagline: "Your airport experience, in one app." / "Havalimanı deneyiminiz, tek uygulamada."
Languages: English (https://voyola.com/), Turkish (https://voyola.com/tr)
Status: mobile app coming soon on the App Store and Google Play; web app at https://app.voyola.com
Contact: hello@voyola.com · Partnerships: partners@voyola.com

## What Voyola does
- Food & Drink: discover participating restaurants and cafés across the airport; see options near your gate.
- Payments: pay with QR at participating locations; track transactions in the app.
- Benefits: earn Voyola Points on eligible transactions and use them on your journey.
- Premium services (coming soon): Lounge, Fast Track, Buggy, Meet & Greet, valet/parking.
- Right moment, right service: suggestions based on your flight timing and location.

## FAQ (short)
- Which airport? Istanbul Airport ecosystem; participating locations are shown in the app.
- Do I need an account? You can browse without one; purchases, payments and benefits need an account.
- Is it live? The app is coming soon — join the waitlist on the home page.
